scope.label: Declared 173,000-review subset — not a full-corpus model run
scope.scope_source: Assignment brief's minimum (>=100,000 classified); Jack's pre-flight instruction 2026-10-20
scope.subset_composition: analysis_10000 (contains checkpoint_500 and cost_100) + golden 50 + 162,950 seeded-random nonempty reviews
scope.subset_method: lowest SHA-256(seed + ':' + review_id) among nonempty rows not already in the dev/golden files

full_corpus_statuses.quarantined: empty_review_text: the 13 empty texts (outside the subset, still recorded)
full_corpus_statuses.not_in_model_scope: sampled out; ingested, hashed and accounted for, never sent to a model

scope.grading_export_scope: grading/ is checked with the 100,000-row subset CSV as the checker's --analysis input, so records.jsonl holds exactly those IDs with contract statuses. not_in_model_scope appears only in the full-corpus accounting file.
scope.golden_labels_policy: Golden 50 texts are classified as part of the subset; Jack's human labels are never model inputs, examples, thresholds or grouping inputs.
scope.memo_counts: All memo/dashboard counts are subset counts.
scope.full_run_projection: Calculator projects 660,609 classifications as an estimated-only scenario; not executed.
scope.subset_core: the original 100,000 core (analysis_10000 + golden 50 + first 89,950 seeded-random) is kept; extended with the next 73,000 reviews in the same seeded order

api_mode: Message Batches API (50% discount) where available; synchronous Messages API only if batch is unavailable for a call
min_coverage_if_cap_binds: Pre-pilot gate: if the projected 100k cost does not fit $5.00, report the largest sample that fits and do not start.

prices_checked.batch_note: 50% batch discount stacks with prompt-caching multipliers

supersedes: Earlier 10,000-sample/$4.50 note in the same pre-flight; Jack replaced it with this 100,000-subset/$5.00 instruction.
spend_cap_enforcement: in code: shared ledger reserves worst-case cost per in-flight request; stop admitting when spent + reserved + next > cap

output_controls.evidence_quote_rule: code uses the whole review text as evidence_quote for short reviews; the model quotes longer ones and code checks the substring

sizing.rule: Jack: largest subset whose conservative projected enrichment spend fits $4.00, keeping ~$1 of the $5.00 cap for verifier, grouping, memo and retries
sizing.history: First sized at N=187,000 from pilot attempt 2 ($2.79e-5 per distinct text). The quote fix (long reviews grouped, explicit quote flag) raised measured output from ~55 to 61.2 tokens/review; re-sized before any main-run work.
sizing.measured_basis: final clean cold pilot (attempt 4, cost/replay.json): conservative enrichment $4.296266 for 143,114 distinct texts = $0.0000300199 per distinct text (retry 5%, output x1.5, 50% prefix-cache misses)
sizing.search: extended the seeded order in steps of 1,000 and counted exact distinct texts per N

deviations.what: memo call runs at effort medium with adaptive thinking (same model claude-haiku-5-5)
deviations.why: at effort low the memo twice produced wrong comparative statements (drafts v1, v2 in evals/memo/) and then failed the new verbatim-fact checks twice; enrichment and verification stay at effort low, thinking off

deviations.what: interruption/resume demo run during the 173,000-subset stage instead of the 10,000 stage
deviations.why: --requests-per-wave was bound at import, so the 10,000 stage finished in 2 waves before the kill point; fixed

deviations.what: recovery pass on the 40 quarantines, requested by Jack: 30 salvaged from saved truncated responses (no new calls), 10 re-sent one review per request (9 completed, 1 still refused)
deviations.why: Jack's instruction after reviewing the overnight run

deviations.what: memo effort raised from medium to high for one bounded regeneration (Jack approved)
deviations.why: three medium-effort regenerations on the post-recovery numbers failed the verbatim-fact checks
